messages:
Raj (AE): Quick thread for BlueFlag POC — they want enterprise onboarding next week. Main asks: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain-claim enforcement and delegated admins. Security team already flagged questionnaire. Pricing wants delta for SCIM/provisioning. Timeline ~2 weeks. Who can own ops + sec answers?
Sophie (SE): I can run the SCIM + RBAC side. They said Azure AD -> SCIM push. We support SCIM v2 and SAML/OIDC. Note: SCIM rate limits by tenant, and group sync needs a config flag. For SAML we need to confirm NameID format + group assertions.
Sophie (SE): Example SCIM basics we typically give customers:
```json
{
  "base_url": "https://api.redwood.example/scim/v2",
  "auth": "Bearer <token>",
  "bulk": false,
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"]
}
```
Sophie (SE): For user matching recommend `externalId` if they can set it on their side; fallback to `userName` (email) but watch for collisions. Deprovision we send `active: false`.
Emma (Product): On RBAC mapping — we support mapping SCIM groups -> Redwood roles, plus custom attribute `redwood_roles` on the user to directly set role list. We also support hierarchical roles for delegated admin. Need to know if BlueFlag expects nested groups.
Noah (Security): From the questionnaire side I need: SAML metadata, SCIM endpoint URL + IP allowlist, expected provisioning volume, retention window for audit logs, KMS/HSM requirements, and proof of SOC2/pen test if they ask. I can draft answers. Also confirm: they want domain claim enforcement for tenant scoping and wildcard subdomain policy? We support domain verification and claim checks; need to confirm subdomain policy.
Lena (Pricing): Pricing quick notes: Hosted API SCIM provisioning included with standard plan up to 5k syncs/day. Above that we charge a sync overage + optional provisioning seat fee. SAML-only POC: no extra infra fee. Dedicated/private deployments: separate reserved-capacity quote. I can give a 1-page delta quote after we lock expected user count.
Owen (Solutions): Proposed POC plan: 1) provide test SAML metadata + test Azure AD tenant 2) do SCIM sync with subset of ~200 users and one group-to-role mapping 3) exercise deprovision + RBAC change events 4) deliver security questionnaire answers & IP allowlist 5) 2-day verification window. Can we target Fri for finish?
Raj (AE): BlueFlag also asked about: partial reprovision (only deprovision selected groups), delegated admins for HR ops, and whether domain claims can be restricted to verified domains only.
Sophie (SE): Partial reprovision is OK — we accept PATCH for selective updates and DELETE for deprovision. For delegated admin we expose a role type `org_admin` that can manage users within tenant but not change billing. We'll need to surface that in the runbook.
Noah (Security): I'll assemble a short security pack: SAML metadata instructions, SCIM TLS requirements, IP allowlist CIDRs, audit log retention (90 days default, can extend), KMS options (customer-managed via KMS), and standard DPA template. I'll ask Legal about EU data residency and DPA clauses; cc'ing them outside this thread.
Lena (Pricing): Ballpark budget for them to tee up: hosted + SCIM for ~10k seats ~ $10k-$25k/mo depending on sync volume and seat licensing. Dedicated will be higher — need usage profile to quote. I'll put together a formal delta quote by EOD tomorrow.
Owen (Solutions): I'll draft the runbook and a short test checklist (SAML metadata, SCIM token, expected user list CSV, sample group mappings). Who will send test metadata?
Raj (AE): I'll get Amy (amy@blueflag.com) to share IdP metadata and the Azure AD admin contact. Assignments: Sophie — run SCIM; Noah — security pack; Lena — pricing delta; Owen — runbook; Raj — collect metadata + schedule. Meeting: Thu 10am PT for live test.
Emma (Product): One edge note — if they use email aliases (plus addressing) we may need to enable `email_normalization` in mapping to avoid dupe users. I'll add that to the runbook.
Sophie (SE): Also flag: if they expect group sync >10k groups, we should enable incremental sync and recommend Dedicated.
Raj (AE): Great. I'll confirm meeting invite once I have IdP metadata. :thumbsup:
Noah (Security): I'll aim to post the questionnaire draft by EOD Thurs so we can hit the meeting with answers.
Lena (Pricing): I'll drop a raw delta here in a few hours.
Owen (Solutions): I'll share the runbook link in #sales once ready.
Raj (AE): Thanks team — recording action items.
